scoring: Partner IQ = public-evidence customer reach (30) + technical capability (25) + revenue leverage (25) + strategic fit (20). Scores are working research priorities, not claims of relationship or willingness to partner.

partners.name: Convergint
partners.evidence: 139 North American offices, 6,800+ experts, 200+ technology partners; enterprise access control, video and building integration.
partners.motion: Executive partnership discussion around open-platform projects, selected verticals, and joint account planning rather than broad reseller recruitment.

partners.name: Securitas Technology
partners.evidence: National U.S./Canada integrator with global capabilities, integrated access, video, intrusion and multi-site security programs.
partners.motion: Validate strategic-vendor openness and identify enterprise programs where Xthings edge, biometric or hybrid architecture fills a portfolio gap.

partners.name: Bosch Building Technologies
partners.evidence: Climatec and Paladin operations are being unified under Bosch Building Technologies; 3,000+ North American building-technology professionals.
partners.motion: Target cross-domain building-security opportunities where open access, edge control and smart-building interoperability complement BAS and life-safety scope.

partners.name: Pavion
partners.evidence: Security, fire and integration provider with access control, video, cloud security and multi-region operations; expanded through Netronix and other acquisitions.
partners.motion: Lead with open architecture, unified access/video workflows and API support on enterprise and multifamily programs.

partners.name: M.C. Dean
partners.evidence: Designs, engineers, integrates, operates and maintains access control, biometrics, video, IT and command systems for federal and commercial customers.
partners.motion: Pursue selected commercial / advanced-manufacturing programs where Xthings can be technically validated without competing with mission-specific incumbent stacks.

partners.name: Security 101
partners.evidence: Nationwide commercial integrator with access control, video, visitor management, managed security and Fortune 500 national-account focus.
partners.motion: Start with one or two franchise / regional offices plus National Accounts; prove a repeatable open-platform offer before wider rollout.

partners.name: Everon
partners.evidence: Large commercial security integrator with national-account capabilities across security, video, fire and life safety; expanded further in 2026.
partners.motion: Validate portfolio white space and national-account use cases where Xthings can add edge, biometric or smart-access differentiation.

partners.name: Stone Security
partners.evidence: Open-platform enterprise integrator with offices across multiple U.S. regions; video, access control, cloud and mobile security; projects in 35 states reported historically.
partners.motion: High-fit technical conversation around open architecture, video/access convergence and selected manufacturing or enterprise accounts.

partners.name: Minuteman Security & Life Safety
partners.evidence: National integrator across video, access control, cybersecurity and emergency communications; enterprise, healthcare, education and critical infrastructure focus.
partners.motion: Target enterprise accounts where hybrid access and open integration can complement existing Genetec-centric programs.

partners.name: SAGE Integration
partners.evidence: Enterprise integrator with offices in Texas, Ohio, Georgia, New Jersey and Tennessee and support for national rollouts.
partners.motion: Co-sell into multi-site enterprise accounts; validate manufacturer openness and technical fit before investing heavily.

partners.name: Tech Systems
partners.evidence: Certified teams nationwide across access control, video, cybersecurity, intrusion and emergency notification; strong critical-infrastructure and industrial coverage.
partners.motion: Focus on manufacturing, data, pharma and multi-site facilities where edge resilience and biometrics create a credible wedge.

partners.name: Albireo Energy
partners.evidence: National building-controls platform serving complex facilities, data centers, healthcare, government and commercial buildings.
partners.motion: Technology / co-sell exploration around building systems, identity, access events and open data workflows rather than traditional security resale.

partners.name: Jensen Hughes
partners.evidence: Vendor-neutral physical and technical security design working with developers, owners and A&E teams from planning through RFP and bid evaluation.
partners.motion: Specifier education, reference architectures and integration proof so Xthings can enter project requirements before integrator selection.

partners.name: Guidepost Solutions
partners.evidence: 10,000+ security projects and 1,000+ assessments; vendor-neutral physical-security consulting and electronic security systems engineering.
partners.motion: Education and technical proof motion. Goal is inclusion in appropriate architectures, not transactional reseller recruitment.

partners.name: Preferred Technologies (Pref-Tech)
partners.evidence: Top-25 U.S. systems integrator serving enterprise customers across government, healthcare, transportation, utilities and commercial sectors; self-performs complex security work.
partners.motion: Texas anchor partner candidate for industrial, enterprise and public-sector adjacent accounts after validating manufacturer fit.

partners.name: LONG Building Technologies
partners.region: AK, CO, ID, MT, OR, UT, WA, WY
partners.evidence: Multi-state building automation and security provider with access control, video, intrusion and cloud/on-premise integration capabilities.
partners.motion: Western-region smart-building and security co-sell, especially where access needs to coexist with broader building controls.

partners.name: Cook Solutions Group
partners.evidence: Commercial security, access control, video and managed services across western markets with multi-site and financial-institution depth.
partners.motion: Regional program around access modernization and existing-system integration; test California, Arizona and Pacific Northwest first.

partners.name: A3 Communications
partners.evidence: Security and protection services across nine southeastern states, including access control, surveillance and related infrastructure.
partners.motion: Southeast route to market for access/video deployments; qualify vertical overlap and partner-program compatibility.

partners.name: GC Security Design
partners.evidence: Fremont-based integrator for offices, data centers, warehouses and commercial facilities nationwide; access, video and low-voltage engineering.
partners.motion: Local lighthouse partner: technical workshop, one co-developed Bay Area opportunity, then national-account expansion if proven.

partners.name: Pro-Tec Design
partners.evidence: 50+ years, 5,327 systems installed, 4,522 clients and 75 expert advisors; access control, video, intrusion and open integration.
partners.motion: Manufacturing, healthcare and government-adjacent Midwest accounts; validate appetite for another access platform in the vendor portfolio.

partners.name: Koorsen Fire & Security
partners.evidence: 75+ years serving commercial customers with access control, video, intrusion and monitoring from single sites to large campuses.
partners.motion: Midwest channel candidate for commercial and industrial accounts after confirming product-line fit and current access-control vendors.

partners.name: Tech Electronics
partners.evidence: Security technologies include access control, video, intrusion and visitor management with A&E support and manufacturer partnerships.
partners.motion: Specifier and integrator motion for Midwest education, healthcare and commercial projects; qualify open-platform fit.

partners.name: South Bay Hardware
partners.evidence: Smart-building and access-control work across multifamily and commercial environments with specification, installation and support capabilities.
partners.motion: High-fit property-development route for ULTRALOQ, common-area access and smart-building integration.

partners.name: Elwin Security
partners.evidence: Commercial access-control and security integrator with field expertise spanning readers, controllers, locks, power, wiring and support.
partners.motion: Fast local technical validation and retrofit motion; ideal for proving Xthings interoperability claims with real properties.

partners.name: Regent5
partners.evidence: Commercial workplace integrator combining access control, cameras, networks, Wi-Fi, AV, lighting and electrical infrastructure.
partners.motion: Test office / hospitality motion where physical access and networking are designed together.
